name: Amy Weintraub
reason: Health-restore re-check (12 Nov 2026), new rule: still out. Her own site amyweintraub.com (robots.txt open, read 12 Nov 2026) makes treatment and replace-medicine claims directly. The Yoga for Depression page says the side effects of antidepressants 'may seem nearly as depressing as the symptoms' and that she 'offers a better solution', calls the book 'the first yoga book devoted exclusively to the treatment of these debilitating conditions', and names dysthymia, anxiety-based depression and bipolar disorder. The home page says yoga 'can help you manage anxiety and depression', sells the card deck Yoga for Your Mood: 52 Ways to Shift Depression and Anxiety, and the site menu is built on Yoga for Anxiety / Depression / Trauma; Yoga Skills for Therapists and the IFS work are clinician-facing. Her novel Temple Dancer and creative-writing courses (amyweintraub.thinkific.com) are not spiritual teaching items on their own.
